title: Glowing toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura behind toothbrush -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='32' ry='40' fill='#1a3a4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Toothbrush handle -->
  <rect x='42' y='35' width='16' height='52' rx='8' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <rect x='44' y='37' width='5' height='48' rx='4' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Handle grip stripes -->
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='70' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='78' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <!-- Neck connecting handle to head -->
  <rect x='44' y='26' width='12' height='12' rx='3' fill='#00b8d4'/>
  <!-- Brush head -->
  <rect x='40' y='14' width='20' height='16' rx='6' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- Bristle base -->
  <rect x='42' y='10' width='16' height='6' rx='2' fill='#d0f8ff'/>
  <!-- Bristle tufts -->
  <rect x='43' y='5' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='4' width='2.5' height='8' rx='1' fill='#e0faff'/>
  <rect x='50' y='3' width='2.5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='53.5' y='4' width='2.5' height='8' rx='1' fill='#e0faff'/>
  <rect x='57' y='5' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Sparkle/shine on handle -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='48' rx='2' ry='8' fill='#b3f5ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Glow sparkles around toothbrush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='2' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='25' r='2.5' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='2' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='85' r='1.5' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#b3f5ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#b3f5ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Small plus-shaped sparkles -->
  <rect x='20' y='40' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='18' y='42' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='78' y='35' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='76' y='37' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66f0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
